findings.title: Partial refund pays out order.total_cents instead of approved amount_cents
findings.evidence: gateway.refund is now called with 'order.total_cents' rather than the 'amount_cents' the support agent approved, so a request to refund a small partial amount issues a full-value money movement to the payment gateway with no further guard.
findings.recommendation: Restore 'return gateway.refund(order.txn_id, amount_cents)' so the gateway receives the approved partial amount; if full refunds are also needed, add an explicit separate code path that passes order.total_cents deliberately.

findings.title: amount_cents parameter becomes dead, silently ignoring caller intent
findings.evidence: The function still declares 'def refund(order, amount_cents)' but the body no longer references 'amount_cents', so callers passing a partial amount get no error and no indication their value was discarded.
findings.recommendation: Use amount_cents in the gateway call; if the parameter is genuinely obsolete, remove it from the signature and update all callers so the API contract change is caught at review time rather than silently mis-billing.
